audit.whatIsWrong: content win[0], win[3] and win[4] read Skill, but all seven whys say Singed wins that stage, the prose says 'Singed wins levels 1-2' and 'Levels 3-6 still belong to Singed', and the packet chart is Singed at every stage.
audit.why: 48.05% over 1613 games is Aatrox's worst matchup in this slice, and the entry's own reasoning is unanimous. A chart that says 'Skill' at Level 1 while the text says Singed free-chips you with no answer teaches the wrong respect level.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike names the wrong ability for Singed's ultimate spike and gives no cooldowns anywhere — the packet flags this matchup for having no cooldown sequencing at all.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is 100s flat, Mega Adhesive 17/16/15/14/13, Fling 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. Those are the three timers the whole lane runs on, and 'commit only with your jungler' means nothing without them.
audit.corrected: 100s Insanity Potion, 17s Mega Adhesive and 10s Fling written into spikes[0], spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and mid both write 'Insanity Potion (Mega Adhesive slow)', conflating two separate abilities. Worse, the three interactions that actually decide the lane are absent: Mega Adhesive GROUNDS, which switches Umbral Dash off completely; Fling into Mega Adhesive ROOTS you; and Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving every source of healing Aatrox has.
audit.why: Riot's text: Mega Adhesive 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it'; Fling 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted'; Insanity Potion 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. Aatrox's entire kit heals — Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash's passive and World Ender's amp — so his ult is not a stat spike against you, it is a hard counter to your win condition. And a grounded Aatrox cannot dash out of the gas he is standing in.
audit.corrected: Grounding, the Fling-into-adhesive root, and the Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail are now stated in spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[0], with the rule 'take your trade before the potion, never after'.

audit.whatIsWrong: No punishable cooldown was ever named.
audit.why: Fling at 10s rank 1 is the one window where Singed cannot reverse your commit; Mega Adhesive at 17s is the one where you can still dash.

edits.before: No clean kill window: even with your Q sweetspot into W chain, Singed Flings you into his own minions and strolls away in Poison Trail. Don't chase him off his wave — you'll lose the trade to gas and Fling.
edits.after: No clean kill window: Mega Adhesive (17s) grounds you, so Umbral Dash is dead the moment you step in it, and a Fling that drops you in the adhesive roots you outright. Step up only in the 10s after Fling.

edits.before: R World Ender heal-amp helps you survive the gas, but Singed 6 gives Insanity Potion (Mega Adhesive slow) and out-tempos your dive — commit only with your jungler or you slow-fry in his poison.
edits.after: World Ender's heal amp survives the gas — until his 100s Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail and halves every heal you own. Take the trade before the potion; after it, drain is not a plan.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 still belong to Singed. Even once your Q pattern is online, a sweetspot into W Infernal Chains rarely sticks — the moment you commit he Flings you into his minions and walks off in Poison Trail, and cornering him off his wave is hard to force. At 6, R lets you dive through the gas with the heal amp, but he spikes with Insanity Potion + Mega Adhesive and out-sustains the poison exchange, so only commit with a gank or a clear cooldown advantage rather than blind.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 still belong to Singed. Even with your Q pattern online, a sweetspot into Infernal Chains rarely sticks — he Flings you into his minions and walks off in Poison Trail, and Mega Adhesive (17s) grounds you so Umbral Dash cannot follow. Get flung into the adhesive and you are rooted. At 6 his 100s Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on the gas, halving your drain, so commit in the window after Fling or with a gank, never blind.

edits.before: Fling you into his minion wave and kite off in Poison Trail
edits.after: Fling you into Mega Adhesive to root, then gas you down

edits.before: At 6 his Insanity Potion + Mega Adhesive spike out-tempos your R dive.
edits.after: At 6 Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on his gas, halving your drain.

edits.before: Singed changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Singed proxy, Fling, ground, and R. Aatrox wins by controlling spacing with his first two Q swings, holding E until the enemy punish tool is committed, and managing the wave so the enemy must walk into the outer edge of his Q. Singed wants to deny Aatrox's normal Q spacing and turn the lane into their preferred pattern.
edits.after: Singed changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Mega Adhesive (W, 17s), which grounds Umbral Dash and roots him if Fling drops him in it, and Insanity Potion, which puts Grievous Wounds on the gas. Aatrox wins only in the 10s after Fling: spacing with the first two Darkin Blade swings and leaving before the poison ticks. Singed wants to proxy and never duel.
